## Dimensional test: 1-qubit quantum vs 2-state classical

Gaps in nats/symbol. *test*: median over seeds / validation-selected run on the standard test set. *long*: the validation-selected run re-scored on 256 sequences of 1024 (paired gap ± SE). *bound*: least KL rate of any 2-state unifilar model: *one-step* is the merge bound with future length 1 (`unifilar_merge_bound`), *block* the tightest over future lengths 1-10 (`best_unifilar_merge_bound`). Both are lower bounds; the block one is tighter.
